assets.name: ember
assets.prompt:
A single piece of user-interface artwork for a video game, drawn as one member of an existing family of icons. Flat geometric vector: every shape constructed from circles, squares and 45-degree chamfers on one grid, one uniform stroke weight throughout, sharp corners left sharp, generous negative space, optically centred, and legible when it is shrunk to 24 pixels. Flat fills only: this is a vector graphic of the kind an SVG file holds. Every shape is one single solid block of colour, exactly the same value at its centre as at its rim, and every edge is a hard boundary where one flat colour stops and the next flat colour begins. The whole image lies on one plane and is built from pure areas of colour, in the register of a printed pictogram on a road sign.

Draw the subject exactly ONCE, filling the frame. The frame holds one instance of one subject at one size, and every pixel outside that one subject is bare background.

A single interface icon for the "ember" element of a monster-collecting game. It is one solid teardrop flame, point upward, its base resting on a short flat bar. Drawn as one flat geometric shape with a uniform stroke weight, centred in the square with an even margin, filling most of the frame, and legible at 24 pixels. This is an icon: one subject drawn as a symbol, given the whole of the frame, with every feature in it large enough to survive being shrunk to 24 pixels.

Every drawn element is filled or stroked in #ff6b4a — that exact colour, at full strength. The only permitted exception is a ground line, which may instead be a muted bone #b7ae9b. Every pixel belonging to the artwork carries either #ff6b4a or the bone, and #ff6b4a is the dominant colour of the artwork rather than a small detail on it.

The background is one flat, uniform, unbroken near-black warm ash field, hex #12100f, filling the entire frame from edge to edge behind the subject. Sample that field at any point — a corner, an edge, the centre, the area directly behind the subject — and it reads exactly #12100f every time: one constant value across the entire field, as though the finished subject had been pasted onto a solid #12100f rectangle. The subject is the bright thing in the frame and the field behind it is the dark thing: light subject on dark field, in that order. The subject floats free: the #12100f field continues unbroken beneath it and on all four sides of it, right up to its outline, so the last pixel outside its edge is #12100f and the first pixel inside it is the accent. Draw only the finished subject: the subject and the flat field are the whole of the image, and the subject's own outline is the only edge anywhere in the frame.

This image is wordless and consists purely of shape. Every region of the frame is either part of the drawn subject or bare background, and wherever a caption, a label or a signature would sit there is bare background instead.
